title: Claude Code now runs itself by default - TCR 08/10/26
description:
Anthropic makes Claude Code's auto mode the default for Pro, Max, and Team accounts on August 14, dropping per-step approval, as an NBER benchmark finds self-executing agents lift econometric-coding success from 74% to 96% for eight cents more, Apple is reportedly qualifying Chinese CXMT memory chips for potential use in future iPhone and MacBook models, and Pinterest tells investors open models run its AI features at under 8% of the cost of what it characterizes as comparable closed systems.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-10-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:51 Claude Code goes auto-by-default
4:41 Apple reportedly tests China's CXMT memory for potential use in future models
7:45 Pinterest and DoorDash run on open models
11:09 The four-day-week promise vs 90-hour sprints
19:54 Close

This episode covers Claude Code's auto-by-default switch and the NBER agent benchmark, Apple's reported testing of CXMT memory for potential use in future iPhone and MacBook models amid the AI chip shortage, Pinterest and DoorDash running on Chinese open models, the four-day-week promise against workers' reports of 90-hour sprints, and Anthropic loosening Fable 5's biology safeguards while keeping the dual-use gate shut.

The day's spine is a single motion: a human checkpoint pulled out where an error is recoverable and hardened where it can never be taken back. Claude Code goes auto-by-default because Anthropic says users already approve 97% of prompts and, in its study of 1,053 paid testers, the agent's own screening caught more actions it labeled harmful than human review, while the NBER paper shows agency, not prompting, is what raises coding success. The same company cuts Fable 5's everyday biology refusals 85% while routing virology and toxicology to Opus 5. Around that spine, capability detaches from origin and price: Pinterest says it runs a fine-tuned Qwen at under 8% of the cost of what it characterizes as a comparable closed system, Apple reaches for Chinese CXMT memory because the buildout outran approved suppliers, and some staff at the firms promising a four-day week report logging 70 to 90 hours as freed capacity gets captured upstream.
